summary: Backend end-to-end tests for the Sistema Global de Bounties (Cacería P2P) — 16/16 pytest pass. Covered every anti-exploit rule from the request: (1) atomic PrimeMeat charge with vip_coins untouched, (2) insufficient funds -> 400, no debit, (3) below min_contract_prime (20000) -> 400, (4) self-target -> 400, (5) request 'amber' ignored — reward.amberium equals system-injected reward_amber_bonus (100), (6) 3 concurrent contracts on distinct sim targets allowed, 4th -> 400 with exact -60000 debit, (7) offline/non-roster target_sid -> 400, (8) cancel refunds fully (wallet restored) and unknown bounty_id -> 400/404, (9) admin simulate-kill is atomic + idempotent (single history entry, second call no-op), (10) POST /bounty/self/start creates self + second call -> 400, (11) WS /api/bounty/ws?token=<jwt> receives first message event=bounty:state {config,board,paused} and delivers bounty:contract_new/bounty:board after REST place, (12) /bounty/history returns items with status in {completed,dead,expired,cancelled}, (13) admin endpoints reject unauthenticated calls (401/403) and accept demo admin. Wallet was inspected via /api/bounty/mine (wallet.coins/vip_coins) as instructed. Demo user had ~5,052,300 PrimeMeat / 450 Amberium; no seed increment needed.
critical_code_review_comments: bounty.py simulate-kill fallback (line ~806) uses str(int(data.target_sid)+1) — will ValueError if target_sid is non-numeric (e.g. real steam names or the demo user's 'demo_0000000001'); currently only reachable when the roster has a single member. Consider a uuid-based fallback for safety.

bounty.py _resolve_death broadcasts 'bounty:completed' with bountyId='múltiple' inside _discord_completed footer — cosmetic only, but the Discord embed footer will show 'BOUNTY ID • múltiple' for multi-contract kills.
server.py file is >19k lines (guideline: split >700). The bounty wiring block (~18843-18949) could live in an adapters module for modularity.

bounty.place_contract silently ignores the request's 'amber' value (correct anti-exploit behavior) but the API contract still accepts it in ContractIn; consider removing 'amber' from ContractIn or documenting that it is ignored server-side so callers don't assume it works.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> {token}. Demo user is admin (role=admin), steam_id demo_0000000001, wallet ~5M PrimeMeat, 450 Amberium. Use Authorization: Bearer <token>. WS: /api/bounty/ws?token=<jwt>.
seed_data_creation: None. Demo user already funded (~5,052,300 PrimeMeat). Sim roster auto-generated by bounty._sim_roster (10 SIM players).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bounty flows validated with new 3-contract limit and system-injected reward_amber_bonus. Sim roster is stable (10 players, sids ~76561190000000000+idx*1337+11). Wallet must be read via /api/bounty/mine.wallet (NOT /api/auth/me) after the new wiring. Cooldown on self-bounty (600s) can cause consecutive self-start tests to skip — the test handles this via pytest.skip. Autouse fixture cancels all placer contracts before/after each test.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All anti-exploit rules pass. Endurecimientos previos (uuid _bid + refund-on-insert-fail in place_contract) confirmed working: insert path did not error in any test, and atomic $gte charge prevents overspend.
